contexts.text: This is said in the past [tense]; and yet [these expressions] regard future things. The internal sense has no relation to times; which is favoured by the Original Language...
Men, from past things, revolve things to come. Not so Spirits, who have no memory of past things, except when it is excited for the sake of certain ends.
That the Angels have no memory of past things... Explained.

The more interior and perfect the Angels are, the less memory of past things they have; and therein consists their happiness... Inasmuch as they have not the memory of past things, they have not the prevision of the future... SE 2956.
Spirits are not allowed to have the memory of past things. This is proper to man...
As to what is eternal (the Angels) have no idea of past and future things; but both past and future things are in their present.
